metadata.description: Agent skills by mys1erious for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents.

plugins.name: ascii-art
plugins.description: Build ASCII art that looks designed: animated and interactive canvas pieces, image, logo and text to ASCII, plain-text art, and loopable videos for X.

plugins.name: explainer-video
plugins.description: Make short narrated explainer videos drawn in code, with real data on screen: script, AI voice with word timings, frame-exact render, music and sound mix, and several styles to compare.

plugins.name: plan-to-walk
plugins.description: Turn a floor plan into a scroll-driven 3D page: an ink plan sheet, a section cut that rises into walls, sun sweeping the drawing into stone, then a walk through the rooms. Typed plans or hand-built landmarks.

plugins.name: take-apart
plugins.description: Build a real object at real scale in three.js from sourced numbers and take it apart: an exploded view with labels, dimension lines, a scale bar and tap cards with sources, on a self-playing timeline.
